tools.name: appstore_app
tools.description: Read-only appstore app operation Normalized App records. Use when: you already have an App Store id or bundle id (from appstore_search or appstore_list) and need the full normalized app record: name, price, category, developer, description. Related tools: appstore_search, appstore_ratings, appstore_

tools.name: appstore_developer
tools.description: Read-only appstore developer operation Normalized App records. Use when: listing every app a developer has published, given their App Store developer id. Related tools: appstore_app, appstore_search.

tools.name: appstore_list
tools.description: Read-only appstore list operation Normalized App records. Use when: browsing a category or collection chart (top free, top grossing, new) instead of searching by keyword. Related tools: appstore_search, appstore_app.

tools.name: appstore_privacy
tools.description: Read-only appstore privacy operation Privacy details envelope. Use when: auditing the data types an app declares collecting under Apple's privacy nutrition label, given its id. Related tools: appstore_app, appstore_ratings.

tools.name: appstore_ratings
tools.description: Read-only appstore ratings operation Ratings summary envelope. Use when: a quick average rating and star-count histogram for an app, without reading individual reviews. Related tools: appstore_reviews, appstore_app.

tools.name: appstore_reviews
tools.description: Read-only appstore reviews operation Review list envelope. Use when: reading paginated customer review text and scores for a specific app id — sentiment analysis, complaint mining, feature requests. Related tools: appstore_ratings, appstore_app.

tools.name: appstore_search
tools.description: Read-only appstore search operation Normalized App records. Use when: resolving a keyword or brand name to App Store app ids before looking up details, ratings, or reviews for a specific app. Related tools: appstore_suggest, appstore_app, appstore_similar.

tools.name: appstore_similar
tools.description: Read-only appstore similar operation Normalized App records. Use when: competitive discovery — surfacing apps the App Store considers similar to a known app id. Related tools: appstore_app, appstore_search.

tools.name: appstore_suggest
tools.description: Read-only appstore suggest operation Suggested search terms envelope. Use when: resolving a partial or fuzzy query into canonical App Store search terms before calling appstore_search. Related tools: appstore_search.

tools.name: brand_fonts
tools.description: Read-only brand brand_fonts operation Extract typography and font information from any website. Use when: you only need the typography/font stack a site uses, not the full brand profile or color palette. Related tools: brand_styleguide, brand_retrieve.

tools.name: brand_retrieve
tools.description: Read-only brand brand_retrieve operation Resolve a full brand profile by company domain, or extract details from one specific page URL. Use when: you have a company domain (or one specific page URL) and need the full brand profile — name, logo, colors, social links, description. Related tools: brand

tools.name: brand_search
tools.description: Read-only brand brand_search operation Search brands by name or domain and get up to 10 lightweight matches with domain, name, and logo. Use when: you only have a fuzzy brand or company name, not a domain, and need candidate matches before calling brand_retrieve. Related tools: brand_retrieve.

tools.name: brand_styleguide
tools.description: Read-only brand brand_styleguide operation Extract a design system from a website: colors, typography, spacing, and more. Use when: extracting a site's design system specifically — color palette, typography scale, spacing — rather than the general brand profile. Related tools: brand_retrieve, brand_

tools.name: googleplay_availability

tools.name: googleplay_categories

tools.name: googleplay_data_safety

tools.name: googleplay_developer

tools.name: googleplay_permissions
tools.description: Read-only googleplay googleplay_permissions operation Declared app permissions. Use when: listing the Android permissions an app declares requesting, given its package id. Related tools: googleplay_app_details, googleplay_data_safety.

tools.name: googleplay_reviews
tools.description: Read-only googleplay googleplay_reviews operation Review list envelope. Use when: reading paginated customer review text and scores for a package id — pass next_token from a prior call to keep paging. Related tools: googleplay_app_details.

tools.name: googleplay_search
tools.description: Read-only googleplay googleplay_search operation Normalized Google Play app search results. tools.name: googleplay_similar_apps
tools.description: Read-only googleplay googleplay_similar_apps operation Apps similar to the given package. Use when: competitive discovery — apps Google Play considers similar to a known package id. Related tools: googleplay_app_details, googleplay_search.

tools.name: googleplay_suggest
tools.description: Read-only googleplay googleplay_suggest operation Suggested search terms envelope. Use when: resolving a partial or fuzzy query into canonical Google Play search terms before calling googleplay_search. Related tools: googleplay_search.

tools.name: hackernews_search

tools.name: hackernews_stories_ask
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_ask operation Recent Ask HN stories, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: recent "Ask HN" discussion threads specifically, not general front-page stories. Related tools: hackernews_item, hackernews_search.

tools.name: hackernews_stories_best
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_best operation Best-ranked stories, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: all-time high-scoring stories rather than what's on the front page right now. Related tools: hackernews_stories_top, hackernews_item.

tools.name: hackernews_stories_job
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_job operation Recent job postings, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: recent job postings on Hacker News specifically. Related tools: hackernews_item.

tools.name: hackernews_stories_new
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_new operation Newest stories, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: the newest submissions in arrival order, before ranking has caught up — good for freshness-sensitive monitoring. Related tools: hackernews_stories_top, hackernews_item.

tools.name: hackernews_stories_show
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_show operation Recent Show HN stories, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: recent "Show HN" project-launch threads specifically. Related tools: hackernews_item, hackernews_search.

tools.name: hackernews_stories_top
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_stories_top operation Top front-page stories, resolved to full items and paginated. Use when: the current front page — highest-ranked live stories right now. Related tools: hackernews_stories_new, hackernews_stories_best, hackernews_item.

tools.name: hackernews_user
tools.description: Read-only hackernews hackernews_user operation Normalized public user profile record. Use when: a public HN account's profile — karma, about text, account age — given their username. Related tools: hackernews_item.

tools.name: reddit_post_by_id
tools.description: Read-only reddit post_by_id operation. One Reddit post plus its comment tree, looked up by post id. Use when: you already have a Reddit post id (from reddit_search_posts or reddit_subreddit_posts) and need the full post and comments. Related tools: reddit_post_by_permalink, reddit_subreddit_posts.

tools.name: reddit_post_by_permalink
tools.description: Read-only reddit post_by_permalink operation. One Reddit post plus its comment tree, looked up by permalink URL instead of a bare id. Use when: you have a full Reddit URL (e.g. pasted by a user) rather than a bare post id. Related tools: reddit_post_by_id.

tools.name: reddit_search_posts
tools.description: Read-only reddit search_posts operation. Site-wide keyword search across Reddit posts. Use when: you don't yet know which subreddit holds relevant discussion and need to search across all of Reddit by keyword. Related tools: reddit_subreddit_posts, reddit_post_by_id.

tools.name: reddit_subreddit_posts
tools.description: Read-only reddit subreddit_posts operation. Listing of posts from one named subreddit, sorted by category (hot/new/top/...). Use when: you already know which subreddit to read and want its current listing rather than a keyword search. Related tools: reddit_search_posts, reddit_post_by_id.

tools.name: reddit_user_activity
tools.description: Read-only reddit user_activity operation. A Reddit user's recent posts and comments, interleaved by time. Use when: profiling a redditor's overall recent activity, not just the posts they authored. Related tools: reddit_user_posts.

tools.name: reddit_user_posts
tools.description: Read-only reddit user_posts operation. A Reddit user's submitted posts only (no comments), filterable by category and time window. Use when: you specifically want what a user posted, not their comments — narrower than reddit_user_activity. Related tools: reddit_user_activity.

tools.description: Read-only webcontext webcontext_map operation Discover URLs belonging to a site, deduplicated, without extracting page content. Use when: discovering what URLs exist on a site before deciding what to scrape or crawl, without paying for page content extraction. Related tools: webcontext_crawl, webcon

tools.name: youtube_channel
tools.description: Read-only youtube youtube_channel operation Normalized channel envelope. Use when: a channel's profile given its channel id, rather than one specific video. Related tools: youtube_video, youtube_playlist.

tools.name: youtube_comments
tools.description: Read-only youtube youtube_comments operation Comment list envelope. Use when: reading viewer comment text for a video id — sentiment or feedback mining. Related tools: youtube_video.

tools.name: youtube_playlist

tools.description: Read-only youtube youtube_related operation Related video envelope. Use when: discovering videos YouTube surfaces as related to a known video id — competitive/topical discovery. Related tools: youtube_video, youtube_search.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Read-only youtube youtube_search operation Search result envelope. Use when: resolving a keyword query to YouTube video ids before pulling details, comments, or a transcript for a specific video. Related tools: youtube_video, youtube_channel.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Read-only youtube youtube_transcript operation Transcript envelope. Use when: you need the spoken/caption text of a video for summarization or search, not just its metadata. Related tools: youtube_video, youtube_comments.

tools.name: youtube_video

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "appstore_suggest" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: appstore_ratings, appstore_reviews, appstore_search, brand_retrieve, googleplay_reviews, googleplay_search, hackernews_item, hackernews_stories_ask, hackernews_stories_show, reddit_post_by_id, reddit_post_by_permalink, reddit_search_posts, reddit_subreddit_posts, reddit_user_activity, reddit_user_posts, web_search_web_search, webcontext_brand, webcontext_crawl, webcontext_map, webcontext_scrape, youtube_comments, youtube_search, youtube_transcript, youtube_video · Private data: appstore_app, appstore_developer, appstore_list, appstore_search, appstore_similar, googleplay_app_details, hackernews_user · Public sink: reddit_post_by_id, reddit_post_by_permalink.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: appstore_ratings, appstore_reviews, appstore_search, brand_retrieve, googleplay_reviews, googleplay_search, hackernews_item, hackernews_stories_ask, hackernews_stories_show, reddit_post_by_id, reddit_post_by_permalink, reddit_search_posts, reddit_subreddit_posts, reddit_user_activity, reddit_user_posts, web_search_web_search, webcontext_brand, webcontext_crawl, webcontext_map, webcontext_scrape, youtube_comments, youtube_search, youtube_transcript, youtube_video · Private data: appstore_app, appstore_developer, appstore_list, appstore_search, appstore_similar, googleplay_app_details, hackernews_user · Public sink: reddit_post_by_id, reddit_post_by_permalink

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
